_note: All text players see for rp_economy. Edit the words on the right side only. Keep every %s: the game fills those in.

bill.paid: %s came out of your bank. Type /finances for the details.
bill.overdrawn: Your bank account is overdrawn: %s. Anything paid by card will fail until it's back above $0.

loan.offer_text:
**Price:** %s  
**Down payment:** %s  
**Loan:** %s at **%s%%** a year (credit score %s, %s)  
**Payment:** %s a week for %s weeks, about %s in all  

Payments come out of your **bank** with your weekly bills. If your bank can't cover one, it's missed: a late fee, a lower credit score, and after %s missed payments in a row the bank takes the car back. You can't sell or trade the car until the loan is paid off.
loan.created: %s a week for %s weeks, taken from your bank with your weekly bills (the first one at least %s days from now). /finances shows the loan.
loan.missed: Your bank couldn't cover the payment on the %s (%s). A %s late fee was added. That's %s missed in a row; at %s the bank takes the car. Credit score: %s. Catch up in /finances.
loan.repo: The bank took back the %s after too many missed payments. The loan is closed. Credit score: %s.
loan.paid_off: The %s is all yours. Credit score: %s.
loan.paid_off_now: Loan paid off: %s from your bank. The car is all yours.
loan.caught_up: Caught up: %s from your bank. Your loan is back on track.
loan.no_sale: This car still has a loan on it. Pay it off first (/finances).
loan.error_no_player: The bank couldn't find your details. Try again.
loan.error_bad_car: The bank can't finance that car.
loan.error_down_small: The down payment has to be at least %s (%s%% of the price).
loan.error_too_small: That's less than %s to borrow. Just buy it outright.
loan.error_score: The bank won't lend with a credit score of %s. Pay what you owe on time to bring it up.
loan.error_max_active: You already have %s car loans. Pay one off first.
loan.error_behind: You're behind on a loan. Catch up in /finances before borrowing more.
loan.error_afford: The bank won't go that high. Your loan payments can be up to %s a week right now, and this one would be %s. Put more down, pick more weeks, or earn more first (it looks at your job income over the last 4 weeks).

finances.title: Your finances
finances.tax_week: This tax week: %s earned, %s income tax
finances.tax_week_desc: Top rate this week: %s%%. The tax week starts over in %s.
finances.tax_week_none: No job income yet this tax week
finances.tax_week_none_desc: Income tax comes off every paycheck and job payout. The tax week starts over in %s.
finances.next_bills_desc: In %s. Only charged while you're in the city.
finances.next_bills_soon_desc: It will be charged within a few minutes.
finances.next_bills_none_desc: Nothing to pay right now. Weekly bills come from car loans and luxury cars over $100,000 (and later rent).
finances.credit_desc: Car loans for you right now: %s%% a year. On-time payments raise your score; missed ones lower it.
finances.credit_none_desc: Too low for the bank to lend. Paying what you owe on time brings it back up.
finances.loan_desc: %s a week, %s of %s payments made, %s%% a year
finances.loan_desc_missed: %s MISSED IN A ROW (the bank takes the car at %s). %s a week, %s%% a year
finances.loan_overdue_desc: Pays the missed payments from your bank and puts the loan back on track.
finances.loan_payoff_desc: From your bank. No fee for paying early. Then the car is all yours.
finances.loan_error_not_enough: Your bank doesn't have enough for that.
finances.loan_error_nothing_overdue: Nothing is overdue on that loan.

treasury.title: Government treasury
treasury.balance_desc: All tax and upkeep collected, minus government paychecks. It never stops anyone's pay.

command.finances_help: See your income tax this week, your next weekly bills and the last ones you paid
command.treasury_help: Staff: the government treasury (taxes in, paychecks out)
command.billsnow_help: Staff: charge a player's weekly bills right now (for testing)

error.not_online: That player isn't in the city.
error.not_loaded: Your finances aren't loaded yet. Try again in a moment.

staff.bills_nothing: %s has no weekly bills right now. Their next ones are due in 7 days.
